One source of truth. Today the fleet is scattered across spreadsheets and outdated software. The fleet is run by five departments at once, but owned by none: each keeps a piece (payroll in HR, contracts in Procurement, deadlines in Facility, coding in Accounting & Finance, access in IT) and no one sees the whole picture. So every department re-enters the same data into tools that don't talk to each other: endless manual entry that multiplies errors and leaves no one in control of the data. And meanwhile costs slip away: overcharges on rental invoices go unseen, over-mileage penalties arrive with no warning, fines stay without a driver to assign them to. And every assignment letter, like every fringe-benefit calculation, is done by hand (and often wrong). And the real cost of the fleet is never accurate and on time: rebuilding it takes weeks and several people: and by the time it lands, there's nothing left to decide. → Five departments to coordinate, and no data everyone can rely on. AI is only as powerful as the data beneath it. Every department is moving faster. Decisions pile up, requests multiply, and a fleet split across five teams can't answer them. Flottando makes the fleet one system, so the AI has something real to work with. Speak to one of our experts Contact Us Flottando gives you one platform that gets departments and people on the same page: fleet data, communications and analytics, in one system, powered by AI. One source of truth The AI does the data entry Each team keeps its own cockpit Real cost, in real time Every vehicle, driver, fuel/toll card, contract, invoice and fine in one place, always current. So every team starts from the same numbers. Drag in invoices, contracts, registration docs or fines: Flottando reads them and files the data against the right vehicle. No re-keying, anywhere. HR sees fringe benefit, Procurement renews and checks contracts, Finance codes to cost centers and accounts: same system, different views. Nobody has to learn anyone else's job. Spend, total cost per vehicle and ESG figures update automatically so leadership decides in real time, not on a month-end reconstruction. From five separate departments to one system the whole company uses every day. Start with the department under the most pressure. Pick the department feeling the weight today. Each page is built around that team's real work, and once the first one is in, it opens the door to the rest. No setup calls, no waiting. 2 Invite your team Your colleagues can join in a few clicks. What teams ask before they start Which department should we start with? Whichever one the fleet weighs on most: HR, Procurement, Facility, Finance or IT. Every department benefits from day one, and once the first one is in, adding the next comes naturally. Do we have to change our existing software? No. Flottando sits on top of the systems you already use (HR, payroll and accounting) and feeds them clean data through public APIs. It integrates with your tools instead of adding one more system to manage. Do we need a dedicated fleet manager? No. Flottando runs the day-to-day (deadlines, documents, pool cars and reporting) so the fleet doesn't need a full-time owner. Where does our data live? In the EU. Flottando is GDPR compliant with a full audit trail, and a DPA is available on request. Is Flottando in Italian and English? Yes. Italian is the default; English is one click away. The whole platform and every department page work in both and many more languages too. Bring the whole company onto one AI-powered system for fleet management.
